From: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Sent: 2026-10-09 09:30:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@zhanjiangpulpandpaperco.example
Cc: mail01@pinewoodstarshipping.example
Subject: VSL-18 - DEVIATION FOR MEDEVAC 6.5 HOURS

Dear Charterers,

Operator informs the charterer of the medical deviation and that the time is not off-hire as it was to save life; the replacement is planned at Zhanjiang.

- Deviation: 6.5 hours
- Replacement port: Zhanjiang

Best regards,
Meridian Fleet Management

-----Original Message-----
From: mail01@benoashippingservices.example
Sent: 2026-10-08 14:20:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Cc: mail01@archipelagoclubcorrespondents.example; mail01@vslpinewoodstar.example
Subject: VSL-18 BENOA - MEDEVAC AT ANCHORAGE

Dear Colleagues,

Agent arranged the medevac at Benoa anchorage: launch alongside 15:30, hospital admitted the seafarer at 17:10; vessel resumed passage at 17:40; deviation 6.5 hours.

- Deviation: 6.5 hours
- Medevac launch: 2026-10-08 15:30
- Resumed: 2026-10-08 17:40

Best regards,
Benoa Shipping Services

-----Original Message-----
From: mail01@archipelagoclubcorrespondents.example
Sent: 2026-10-08 08:10:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Cc: mail01@vslpinewoodstar.example
Subject: RE: VSL-18 MEDICAL - CREW MEMBER ABDOMINAL PAIN

Dear Colleagues,

The doctor advises hospital examination within 12 hours; the correspondent proposes landing at Benoa; cost of the hospital and repatriation is for the P&I club.

- Advice: landing at Benoa, within 12 hours

Best regards,
Archipelago Club Correspondents

-----Original Message-----
From: mail01@vslpinewoodstar.example
Sent: 2026-10-08 05:50:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Cc: mail01@archipelagoclubcorrespondents.example
Subject: VSL-18 MEDICAL - CREW MEMBER ABDOMINAL PAIN, REQUEST ADVICE

Dear Colleagues,

The master reports an able seaman with severe abdominal pain since last night, no improvement after treatment; asks for medical advice and a nearby port.

- Position: Lombok Strait approaches, 120 nm from Benoa

Best regards,
Master MV Pinewood Star
